title: Strengthen NIST SP 800-53 Supply Chain Assurance for Defense Electronics
summary: See how Palitronica supports NIST SP 800-53 supply chain controls with independent hardware and firmware verification for provenance, supplier assurance, tamper detection, inspection and component authenticity.
body_markdown:
NIST SP 800-53 establishes important controls for managing cybersecurity and supply chain risk, but compliance documentation alone does not independently verify the electronics entering a system. Palitronica extends supply chain assurance into the hardware and firmware itself, providing technical evidence to help manufacturers and defense organizations verify the electronics they build, buy and deploy.


This guide outlines how Palitronica’s Anvil Electronics Assurance Platform can support key NIST SP 800-53 controls related to supply chain risk management, provenance, supplier assessment, tamper detection, component inspection and authenticity. It also shows how physics-based hardware verification and black-box firmware analysis can add objective electronics assurance throughout manufacturing, acquisition and sustainment.


###


Verification helps prove what is actually in your electronics.


See how independent hardware and firmware testing can strengthen NIST SP 800-53 supply chain controls and provide objective evidence beyond supplier documentation, certifications and conventional manufacturing tests.
